correctness.rationale: For the unaugmented entry-equation scheme X^m=0, first-order expansion gives D_m(A)(B)=sum_{j=0}^{m-1}A^jBA^(m-1-j). On an ordered pair of Jordan blocks b,c<=m, identify rectangular matrices with k[u,v]/(u^b,v^c). Multiplication by h_m=sum u^j v^(m-1-j) satisfies (u-v)h_m=0, and the nonzero homogeneous multiples are exactly degrees through b+c-m-1; they are linearly independent in every characteristic, so rank is max(0,b+c-m). Summing proves formula, dual-number fiber q^(n^2-R_m), and GL_n orbit size gives full labeled matrix census. Dominance of partition (m^a,r) and centralizer formula give reduced dense orbit dimension n^2-(ma^2+2ar+r); rank computation yields tangent excess min(r,m-r), vanishing precisely when m divides n; regular local generic reducedness follows from equal tangent and Krull dimensions. Fresh modular row elimination verified ordered-pair ranks p=2,3,5 through m=6 and dense excess n<=11,m<=9. Finite checks corroborate the characteristic-free symbolic argument.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks are restricted to explicitly stated bounds; infinite assertions rest on inspected analytic proof.

originality.rationale: Prasad–Singla–Spallone Section 6.2 gives the same linearized map L_N on Jordan blocks and addresses similarity classifications, but the inspected sections do not furnish the stated uniform block-rank plus all-partition labeled dual-number matrix count and generic reducedness boundary. Weyman Theorems 1–2 concern the radical orbit-closure ideal with characteristic-polynomial generators imposed, unlike this unaugmented scheme. Earlier square-zero ring enumeration and one-block nilpotency-index tables cover special cases explicitly excluded from novelty. Algebraic simplification of Prasad et al could implicitly yield the rank formula: meaningful priority risk.
residual_risks: Earlier literature may explicitly compute rank of L_N on all rectangular blocks, reducing novelty of the rank formula; primary Prasad Section 6.2 must be credited.
Special cases m=2 and a single Jordan block are covered prior art, not independent advances.
No claim about arbitrary chain rings, global reducedness, or dual-number similarity classes.
